title: Capture mkvextract VobSub stdout
summary: Preserve mkvextract stdout warnings in VobSub extraction failures and cover stdout-only mkvextract exit 1 behavior.
reason: Hellboy II VobSub extraction failed because mkvextract emitted Matroska resync errors on stdout while stderr was empty, leaving the retained failure marker with only a generic exit-code reason.
behavior_before: VobSub extraction failures only summarized mkvextract stderr, so stdout-only failures were recorded as generic mkvextract exit codes even when mkvextract reported the actual Matroska structure problem.
behavior_after: VobSub extraction failures preserve the first available mkvextract diagnostic stream, including stdout, and summarize it into the failure reason without treating partial IDX/SUB output as success.
manual_validation: .\ops\pipeline\runtime\PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\ops\pipeline\entrypoints\MediaPipeline.ps1 -ConfigPath <temp Hellboy VobSub-preserve config> -SingleFile <Hellboy II rerun workspace source> - passed; processed publish=published

Published output exists at \\LAYNE-SERVER\Users\Layne\Videos\outsource\Movies\Hellboy II The Golden Army (2008)\Hellboy II The Golden Army (2008).mkv with length 3262776333 bytes
rollback_plan: Revert the VobSub stdout-preservation helper changes and the added unit coverage; operational reruns can continue using the prior config behavior if VobSub OCR is intentionally required.
notes:
